# Trapani Booking

A specialized booking platform for car rentals, transfers, and excursions in Trapani and Favignana.

## Core Services

- Car Rentals: Booking and management of rental cars in Trapani.
- Transfers & Taxi: Specialized transfer services with defined routes and destinations.
- Excursions: Booking for various excursions and tours in the Trapani/Favignana area.

## Site Structure

- Home: Main landing page (localized).
- Car Rentals: /rent/cars/trapani
- Transfers: /transfer-taxi/trapani
- Excursions: /excursions-trapani
- Prices & Destinations: /prices-and-destinations
- Reviews: /reviews
- Partners: /partners
- FAQ: /FAQ
- Contact Us: /contact-us

## Technical Details

- Framework: Laravel
- Frontend: Livewire
- Localizations: Italian (it), English (en)
- Key Features: Dynamic pricing per time period, booking status tracking, SEO meta management, and a comprehensive admin dashboard.
